Subject: Project opening session — scheduling, attendee roster, and day-of ops

Hi Evan —

Great to be kicking this off with GreenHarbor. We usually run a 45–60 minute project opening session to align on success metrics, technical owners, and the immediate implementation plan. Proposed slots (all times in UTC-8 / PST):

- Wed Dec 9, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT (18:00–19:00 UTC)
- Thu Dec 10, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT (17:00–18:00 UTC)
- Mon Dec 14, 2026 — 13:00–14:00 PT (21:00–22:00 UTC)

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions and roles (5m)
2) Success criteria and milestones (10m)
3) Implementation plan & responsibilities (15m)
4) Technical overview — auth, networking, and test data (10m)
5) Next steps & immediate action items (5–10m)

Attendees from Redwood (recommended): Naomi Feldman — CS Lead (host), Marcus Lin — Implementation Manager, Monica Patel — Solutions Engineer. Please add your technical lead and any procurement or security contacts you want on the call.

Attached: GreenHarbor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pre-kickoff items we ask to complete).

If you confirm a preferred slot I’ll send the calendar invite and a join link (Zoom + dial-in). Also let me know if you prefer a separate 30-minute technical-only session after the opening session.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
